svg.title: Talk to Data — Complete Build Roadmap
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the 5-stage build plan from setup to submission for NatWest Code for Purpose 2026

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me the exact terminal commands to set up the project folder, virtual environment, and install all dependencies for the Talk to Data project')
g.text: GitHub repo · venv · requirements.txt · .env.example · Apache 2.0 LICENSE

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write the complete code for schema_extractor.py that reads a CSV or Excel file with Pandas and returns column names, types, and 3 sample rows as a structured dict')
g.text: Pandas reads CSV/Excel · infers column types · builds schema context for LLM

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write the complete llm_client.py with Groq as primary using llama-3.3-70b-versatile and Gemini 2.5 Flash as fallback, with automatic retry on 429 errors')
g.text: Groq primary (llama-3.3-70b) · Gemini 2.5 Flash fallback · auto-retry on 429

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write sql_generator.py, sql_executor.py with DuckDB safety validation, and answer_generator.py — the full NL to SQL to plain English pipeline')
g.text: sql_generator · DuckDB executor · safety validator · answer_generator

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write the complete chart_selector.py that picks bar, line, or pie chart based on query type and renders with Plotly Express')
g.text: Rule-based chart picker · bar / line / pie / table · Plotly Express renderer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write the complete app.py Streamlit frontend with file upload, chat input, answer display with SQL transparency panel, and Plotly chart')
g.text: File upload · chat box · answer + chart display · SQL source panel

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write meaningful unit tests for schema_extractor, sql_executor safety validator, and answer_generator using pytest')
g.text: pytest unit tests · 2 sample CSV datasets · meaningful assertions, no placeholders

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write the complete README.md for the NatWest Code for Purpose submission covering overview, features, install instructions, tech stack, usage examples, architecture, and limitations')
g.text: README.md with all NatWest sections · Streamlit Cloud deploy · DCO sign-off check

svg.text: Tap any stage to generate that code
